dtv.ex: 정답 ② bossy — 우두머리 행세를 하는
정답 ③ less-than-desirable — 그다지 바람직하지 않은
정답 ① second chance — 두 번째 기회
정답 ④ label — 꼬리표를 붙이다, 낙인찍다
정답 ③ shut out — 차단하다, 내쫓다
정답 ② in a rush — 서둘러
정답 ① cut back on — ~을 줄이다

dtr.en: In a rush to meet work, school, family, or household responsibilities, people cut back on their sleep, thinking it won't be a problem, because all of these other activities seem much more important.
dtr.ko: 일, 학교, 가족 또는 집안의 책임을 다하려고 서두르느라, 사람들은 그것이 문제가 되지 않을 거라고 생각하면서 잠을 줄이는데, 왜냐하면 이 모든 다른 활동들이 훨씬 더 중요해 보이기 때문이다.
pt: In a rush to ~ = ~하려고 서둘러 (문장 앞 긴 수식어)
because 이유 부사절 · seem + 형용사 · much 비교급 강조

rows.w: In a rush to meet work, school, family, or household responsibilities,
rows.ko: 일, 학교, 가족 또는 집안의 책임을 다하려고 서두르느라
koAlt: 일, 학교, 가족, 집안일의 책임을 다하려고 서둘러
일, 학교, 가족, 또는 집안의 책임을 충족시키려고 서두르며
일, 학교, 가족, 가정의 책임을 다하기 위해 서둘러서
서둘러 일, 학교, 가족, 집안의 책임을 다하려고
일, 학교, 가족 혹은 집안일의 의무를 다하려 서두르면서
일, 학교, 가족, 집안의 책임을 맞추려고 서두르느라
rows.pt: in a rush to부정사 = ~하려고 서둘러, meet responsibilities = 책임을 다하다

rows.w: people cut back on their sleep,
rows.pt: 주어 people, 동사 cut back on

rows.w: because all of these other activities

koAlt: 훨씬 더 중요한 것 같기 때문이다
rows.pt: seem + 형용사 = ~해 보이다, much = 비교급 강조(훨씬)

dtr.en: But research reveals that a number of vital tasks carried out during sleep help to maintain good health and enable people to function at their best.
dtr.ko: 그러나 연구는 잠자는 동안 수행되는 많은 매우 중요한 일들이 좋은 건강을 유지하는 것을 돕고 사람들이 최상의 상태로 기능할 수 있게 한다는 것을 밝힌다.
pt: tasks [carried out during sleep] = 과거분사 후치 수식
help to ~ and enable people to ~ = 동사 병렬 · enable + O + to부정사

rows.w: that a number of vital tasks
rows.pt: 명사절 that (reveals의 목적어), a number of = 많은
과거분사 carried out이 tasks를 뒤에서 꾸밈

koAlt: 좋은 건강을 유지하는 데 도움이 된다
rows.pt: that절의 동사 help (주어 tasks), help to부정사 = ~하는 것을 돕다
help와 enable이 and로 병렬, enable + O + to부정사 = O가 ~할 수 있게 하다

dtgx.w: The town canceled its outdoor festival because the forecast predicted a powerful storm.
dtgx.en: The town canceled its outdoor festival because the forecast predicted a powerful storm.
dtgx.ex: because 뒤 the forecast predicted ~ = 절 → 접속사 because — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: Despite he had little formal training, the young scientist made an important discovery.
dtgx.en: Despite he had little formal training, the young scientist made an important discovery.
dtgx.ex: 뒤에 he had ~ = 주어+동사 절 → 전치사 Despite를 접속사 Although로

dtgx.w: Most of the passengers slept quietly during the long flight across the Pacific.
dtgx.en: Most of the passengers slept quietly during the long flight across the Pacific.
dtgx.ex: during 뒤 the long flight = 명사구 → 전치사 during — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: Although the medicine tasted quite bitter, most of the patients took it without complaint.
dtgx.en: Although the medicine tasted quite bitter, most of the patients took it without complaint.
dtgx.ex: Although 뒤 the medicine tasted ~ = 절 → 접속사 Although — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: The highway was closed for several hours because of an accident near the tunnel.
dtgx.en: The highway was closed for several hours because of an accident near the tunnel.
dtgx.ex: because of 뒤 an accident = 명사구 → 전치사 because of — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: It was so a remarkable discovery that the scientists published it within a week.
dtgx.en: It was so a remarkable discovery that the scientists published it within a week.
dtgx.ex: such + a + 형용사 + 명사 + that → so를 such로 (so는 so remarkable a discovery 어순)

dtgx.w: The launch was delayed by a day, however the satellite still reached orbit on schedule.
dtgx.en: The launch was delayed by a day, however the satellite still reached orbit on schedule.
dtgx.ex: however는 부사라 두 절을 이을 수 없음 → but(yet)으로

dtgx.w: As night fell over the valley, the temperature dropped by almost ten degrees.
dtgx.en: As night fell over the valley, the temperature dropped by almost ten degrees.
dtgx.ex: As + 절(night fell ~) = 접속사 as(~할 때, ~하면서) — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: While the researchers were collecting samples, a sudden storm hit the island.
dtgx.en: While the researchers were collecting samples, a sudden storm hit the island.
dtgx.ex: While 뒤 the researchers were collecting ~ = 절 → 접속사 While — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: During the volcano was erupting, thousands of nearby residents fled to safer areas.
dtgx.en: During the volcano was erupting, thousands of nearby residents fled to safer areas.
dtgx.ex: 뒤에 the volcano was erupting = 절 → 전치사 During을 접속사 While로

dtgx.w: In spite of the high price, the new electric car sold out within a week.
dtgx.en: In spite of the high price, the new electric car sold out within a week.
dtgx.ex: In spite of 뒤 the high price = 명사구 → 전치사 — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: Although his poor eyesight, he became one of the most famous painters of his time.
dtgx.en: Although his poor eyesight, he became one of the most famous painters of his time.
dtgx.ex: 뒤에 his poor eyesight = 명사구 → 접속사 Although를 전치사 Despite로

dtgx.w: The volunteers stayed cheerful despite having to work outdoors in freezing weather.
dtgx.en: The volunteers stayed cheerful despite having to work outdoors in freezing weather.
dtgx.ex: despite + 동명사(having to work) → 전치사 뒤 동명사 — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: Although its winters are cold and dark, nearly half of its residents ride a bicycle to work or school.
dtgx.en: Although its winters are cold and dark, nearly half of its residents ride a bicycle to work or school.
dtgx.ex: Although + 절(its winters are ~) — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: In the 1970s, because of rising oil prices and growing traffic jams, city leaders decided to invest in wide bike lanes separated from car traffic.
dtgx.en: In the 1970s, because of rising oil prices and growing traffic jams, city leaders decided to invest in wide bike lanes separated from car traffic.
dtgx.ex: because of + 명사구(rising oil prices and growing traffic jams) — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: Today, the city even clears snow from bike paths before it clears the roads, so that people can keep riding all year round.
dtgx.en: Today, the city even clears snow from bike paths before it clears the roads, so that people can keep riding all year round.
dtgx.ex: so that + 절(people can keep ~) = ~하도록 — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: Many visitors are surprised that cycling there feels so safe that parents let young children ride alone.
dtgx.en: Many visitors are surprised that cycling there feels so safe that parents let young children ride alone.
dtgx.ex: so + 형용사(safe) + that + 절 — 맞는 문장

rows.w: The professor's lecture on black holes was such interesting that nobody left early.
rows.en: The professor's lecture on black holes was such interesting that nobody left early.
rows.ex: 뒤에 명사 없이 형용사만(interesting) + that절 → so + 형용사 + that ~ → such를 so로 (such는 such + (a) 형용사 + 명사 + that)

rows.w: Although surrounded by tall buildings, the small park stays quiet most of the day.
rows.en: Although surrounded by tall buildings, the small park stays quiet most of the day.
rows.ex: Although (it is) surrounded — 접속사 뒤 '주어+be동사'는 생략 가능 — 맞는 문장

rows.w: While the three hours that the debate lasted, neither candidate mentioned the budget even once.
rows.en: While the three hours that the debate lasted, neither candidate mentioned the budget even once.
rows.ex: that the debate lasted는 hours를 꾸미는 관계절 → While 뒤는 명사구(the three hours) → 접속사 While을 전치사 During으로

rows.w: Despite many drivers complained about losing road space at first, the lanes were soon filled with cyclists.
rows.en: Despite many drivers complained about losing road space at first, the lanes were soon filled with cyclists.
rows.ex: 뒤에 many drivers complained = 주어+동사 절 → 전치사 Despite를 접속사 Although(Though)로

rows.w: Because of what the doctor told her, she stopped drinking coffee late at night.
rows.en: Because of what the doctor told her, she stopped drinking coffee late at night.
rows.ex: what the doctor told her = 명사절 → 전치사 Because of 뒤에 올 수 있음 — 맞는 문장
